description: DRAFT (scripts/block-face/draft-type.ts (src/canalRecall/blockFace/typeDraft.ts)) for the review turn. Timorpleinbuurt-Noord family 1900-1904, 5 storeys, 4.9-6.4 m wide: 55 pands on 4 block faces; median cornice 15.29 m, 3 window columns, wall #64564e. Pane layout, head kind, cornice kind, crowns and ground variants are NOT measured: see draft.unmeasured.

match.note: drafted: 55 pands, 4 faces; see draft.fields for n and spread of every number

plain.note: placeholder: 40 of 55 pands show a skyline crown over the cornice (draft.observations); the crown kind is for the review turn

roof.evidence: draft placeholder: 55 pands, 3DBAG roof shape slanted; the covering and pitch are not measured

rhythm.bays: 3 window axes (most frequent window-column count on the opening mask (44 of 55 pands; a miscount loses a window, so the mode, not the median))
rhythm.windowsPerStorey: ground: not read | upper storeys: 3 each
rhythm.groundFloor: not measured (draft): the ground storey is not read
